caption:
A Sydney-founded AI cloud company is now on Real Madrid's sponsor list.

Real Madrid named IREN a new official sponsor on Sunday, reported as the club's official AI cloud partner. No length or fee was announced. It follows IREN's Golden State Warriors jersey patch in June, reportedly worth more than US$50m a year, and its purchase of Spanish data centre developer Nostrum Group.

Also today: University of Tasmania x Tasmania Devils, Frontieras x Cadillac F1, AIMS x MPL Indonesia.

evergreen.caption:
The Tasmania Devils don't play an AFL game until 2028, and the partner list is already stacked.

Blundstone owns the front of the guernsey on a seven-year deal, Cadbury has the back for five years and Firmus Technologies is on the shorts for six. New Balance makes the kit, and this week the University of Tasmania signed on as higher education partner.
